line_items.reasoning: Q4 revenue came in at $828M, exceeding the guided range of $767M–$771M by over $57M (~900+ bps above the high end), and full-year revenue of ~$2.87B surpassed the raised guidance midpoint of $2.807B.
U.S. commercial revenue grew 64% YoY with full-year TCV booked of $803M (up 134% YoY), far exceeding the guided threshold of >$687M and at least 50% growth for full-year 2024.
Q4 adjusted operating margin reached 45% (implying ~$373M in adjusted operating income), well above the guided $298M–$302M range (~39% margin), marking the strongest margin in company history.
Full-year adjusted free cash flow of $1.25B significantly exceeded the guidance floor of >$1B, with Q4 alone contributing $517M at a 63% margin.

GAAP operating income was achieved for the full year as guided, though Q4 GAAP operating margin compressed to just 1% due to a one-time $131M SAR-related expense acceleration, creating noise but not a structural miss against the guidance commitment.
